User Story: As a parent, I want to sign up for an account so that I can monitor my child at the preschool.
Acceptance Criteria: Sign-up form accepts name, email and password; account is created with Pending status; admin must approve before login.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to sign up for an account so that I can manage my assigned students.
Acceptance Criteria: Sign-up form accepts teacher details; account stays Pending until approved by the admin.

User Story: As a user, I want to log in with my email and password so that I can access my dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid credentials open the dashboard for the user's role; invalid credentials show an error; pending/archived accounts cannot log in.

User Story: As a user, I want to sign in with my Google account so that I don't need to remember another password.
Acceptance Criteria: User completes reCAPTCHA, chooses a Google account and is signed in to the matching account.

User Story: As a user, I want to reset my password with a code sent to my email so that I can recover my account.
Acceptance Criteria: User requests a reset, receives an OTP by email, can resend it, enters it and sets a new password.

User Story: As an admin, I want to approve new accounts so that only legitimate parents and teachers can use the system.
Acceptance Criteria: Pending accounts are listed; admin approves them; the user receives an approval email and can now log in.

User Story: As an admin, I want to create, edit, archive and reactivate accounts so that user records stay accurate.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can add a user, update details, archive (blocks login) and reactivate an account.

User Story: As a user, I want to update my profile and photo so that others can recognize me.
Acceptance Criteria: User edits own profile fields and uploads a photo; changes are saved and shown in the sidebar.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage Google sign-in and reCAPTCHA credentials securely so that login integrations keep working.
Acceptance Criteria: Access requires OTP or PIN verification; secret values are never displayed; saved credentials are used for login.

User Story: As an admin, I want to create and edit classes so that students are organized into sections.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin enters a unique class name and optional description; renaming updates all student and teacher records.

User Story: As an admin, I want to assign a teacher to one or more classes so that each class has a responsible teacher.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher dropdown lists all active teachers, including those already leading another class; all students in the class are assigned to that teacher.

User Story: As an admin, I want to archive classes that are no longer used so that the class list stays clean.
Acceptance Criteria: Archiving is blocked while the class has active students; archived classes can be restored.

User Story: As an admin, I want to add and archive students so that the student list reflects who is enrolled.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin adds a student with class and parent; archived students are hidden from active lists but kept on record.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to view and edit my assigned students' information so that their records are accurate.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher sees only assigned students; can edit name, class, guardian and birthdate; changes are saved.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to filter my assigned students by class so that I can focus on one class at a time.
Acceptance Criteria: Class dropdown lists 'All classes' and each of the teacher's classes; the table shows only students of the selected class.

User Story: As a teacher or admin, I want to view a student's details and authorized pickup persons so that I have complete information in one place.
Acceptance Criteria: Details & Pickup opens a popup with student info and the list of authorized pickup persons.

User Story: As an admin, I want to open an enrollment period so that families know when they can apply.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin sets start/end dates and starts the period; the open/closed status is shown to all users.

User Story: As a parent, I want to submit an enrollment application for my child so that my child can be admitted.
Acceptance Criteria: Application form is available only while enrollment is open; submission is saved as Pending.

User Story: As an admin, I want to approve or reject enrollment applications so that only accepted children become students.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin reviews each application; approving creates the student record; rejecting records the decision.

User Story: As an admin, I want to keep detailed student and teacher records with private documents so that school files are stored securely.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin creates/updates records and uploads, views and deletes documents; only admins can access them.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to take attendance for my whole class at once so that I can record it quickly each day.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher marks each student Present, Absent, Late, Tardy or Excused and saves the class in one action.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to generate attendance reports for a date range so that I can review attendance patterns.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher selects class and dates; the report lists each student's attendance and highlights absences.

User Story: As a parent, I want to see my child's attendance and be notified of updates so that I know whether my child attended school.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent views attendance history; a notification is shown when attendance is recorded.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to record my students' progress with photos so that parents can see what their child is learning.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher creates activity/weekly/monthly entries with assessment and evaluation; attaches photos from device or Google Drive (JPG/PNG/WEBP, max 5 MB).

User Story: As an admin, I want to review academic progress entries so that I can ensure the quality of teacher reports.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin views all progress entries and marks them as reviewed.

User Story: As a parent, I want to view my child's academic progress and photos so that I can follow my child's development.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees only their linked child's entries and photos.

User Story: As an admin, I want to create fees and record cash payments so that student balances are up to date.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin creates a fee; recording a payment updates the status to Partial or Paid; payments can be corrected or voided.

User Story: As a parent, I want to view my child's fees and receipts so that I know what I have paid and what I still owe.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees fee balances and status and can open a numbered receipt for each payment.

User Story: As an admin or teacher, I want to send payment reminders so that parents settle their balances on time.
Acceptance Criteria: Reminder can be sent to one parent or all parents with balances; the email delivery summary is shown.

User Story: As an admin or teacher, I want to create school events for chosen audiences and classes so that the right people are informed.
Acceptance Criteria: Event has title, description, date, time and venue (map); audience and target classes are selectable; recipients receive email and notification.

User Story: As an admin, I want to approve events created by teachers so that only accurate events are published.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher events are Pending until the admin approves or rejects them; drafts are not published.

User Story: As a parent, I want to see the school calendar so that I don't miss school activities.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees only published events meant for parents and their child's classes.

User Story: As an admin, I want school events copied to the school Google Calendar so that the calendar is available outside the system.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin connects a Google Calendar; published events sync automatically; failed syncs can be retried.

User Story: As a user, I want to connect my personal Google Calendar so that school events appear in my own calendar.
Acceptance Criteria: User consents and connects; can add selected events, sync on request and disconnect.

User Story: As a parent, I want to privately message my child's teacher so that I can ask about my child.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent opens a direct conversation with the teacher; messages appear in both inboxes; no rename option in private chats.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to create group conversations with parents so that I can communicate with several families at once.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher creates a group, sees its members, sends messages and can rename the group.

User Story: As a user, I want to receive in-app notifications so that I am aware of important updates.
Acceptance Criteria: Notifications list shows new items; user can mark them as read.

User Story: As a parent, I want to list who is allowed to pick up my child so that my child is only released to trusted people.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent adds, edits and removes authorized pickup persons.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to verify the person picking up a pupil so that children are released safely.
Acceptance Criteria: Teacher selects the student and the listed authorized person and confirms the release; unlisted persons cannot be confirmed.

User Story: As an admin or teacher, I want to send emergency alerts with a severity level so that parents are informed immediately.
Acceptance Criteria: Alert has a severity (Low/Moderate/High/Critical) and target (whole school, classes or students); email delivery summary is shown.

User Story: As an admin or teacher, I want to post updates and an all-clear on an alert so that parents know the situation has changed.
Acceptance Criteria: Updates and all-clear are added to the alert timeline; alerts can be archived, restored or deleted.

User Story: As a parent, I want to acknowledge an emergency alert so that the school knows I received it.
Acceptance Criteria: Parent sees the alert and taps Acknowledge; the acknowledgement is recorded.

User Story: As an admin, I want student, fee and attendance reports so that I can monitor the whole school.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin generates each report type and views the results.

User Story: As a user, I want an overview dashboard so that I can see key information at a glance.
Acceptance Criteria: Overview shows role-specific summary statistics (e.g. number of students, active students).

User Story: As an admin, I want to view an activity log so that I can track important actions in the system.
Acceptance Criteria: Important actions (e.g. class created, account approved) are logged with user and time and listed for the admin.
